rootCause.summary: writeCache used SIGNED_URL_CACHE_TTL_MS * 1000, treating milliseconds as seconds. Server cache TTL inflated to ~8.3 days while GCS V4 signatures expire after 45 minutes.
rootCause.symptom: API returned cached=true, expiresIn≈707885; GCS returned ExpiredToken

changes: Store signedUrlExpiresAt parsed from X-Goog-Date + X-Goog-Expires
Purge cache entry when signature expired or within 30s buffer
Return expiresIn as min(cache remaining, signature remaining)
Client cache validates GCS signature before reuse

tests.api-server/rhymesSignedUrlCache: 3/3 pass (expired purge, TTL inflation regression, expiresIn cap)
